name: traceglass-monorepo
description: Flight recorder & audit dashboard for autonomous agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @traceglass/core && npm run build -w @traceglass/sdk && npm run build -w @traceglass/mcp && npm run build -w @traceglass/otel && npm run build -w @traceglass/web && npm run build -w traceglass
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/sdk packages/mcp packages/otel packages/cli
